constraints.timing.duration.tolerance_ms.matched: Frame Rate: 25 (1080i/25); Section 2.2.3.6 Bild/Ton-Versatz: 'Ton darf dem Bild um nicht mehr als 40 ms voreilen, Ton darf dem Bild um nicht mehr als 60 ms nacheilen' (EBU R37)
constraints.timing.duration.tolerance_ms.note: 40ms = one video frame at the document's own stated 25fps, same derivation clearcast_commercials used for this field. The document separately states a literal '40 ms' figure in its EBU R37 audio/video-sync (lip-sync) tolerance, a different concept (A/V offset, not video/audio duration matching) that coincidentally matches this value. Flag for human review before trusting as a hard duration-match tolerance — the frame-duration derivation, not the R37 coincidence, is the basis for this record.
